additional_info.subject: ID0433230-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312562229/30]Screensaver not visible CRM:02889000139
additional_info.body:
Hi Thibaut, good morning.
Solved - there was a conflict with the name of the screensaver. When you are providing the screensavers, in the name you need to remove any "spaces".
Example:
Photo 1.png -> wrong
Photo_1.png -> correct
Here is a photo of the screen, be aware that the Web version is not corresponding to the real version, it's just to prove that it's there correctly:
Since it's been resolved, I will close the ticket.
Have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
